subject: english
chapter_title: Footprints without Feet: The Invisible Man Griffin

concepts.title: The Fresh Muddy Imprints of Bare Feet
concepts.definition: Two boys in London are startled by fresh muddy imprints of a pair of bare feet that appear without any person walking, for a scientist named Griffin has made his body invisible and only his footprints in mud show his movement.
concepts.key_idea: The boys follow the footprints until they fade and vanish, and the mystery of the invisible walker opens the tale.

solution_steps.explain: Muddy imprints of bare feet appear on the steps, then stop, with no man in sight.

solution_steps.action: explain the science behind the sight
solution_steps.explain: Griffin has swallowed a drug that made his body invisible like a sheet of glass, though he still walks in the mud.
The boys follow the prints until they fade, showing the limits of the invisibility.

concepts.title: Griffin the Lawless Scientist
concepts.definition: Griffin is a brilliant but lawless scientist who set fire to his landlord's house over a disagreement and, stripped of clothing and money, wanders the cold streets of London invisible and homeless.
concepts.key_idea: His discovery of invisibility serves mischief first, since he uses it to escape rather than to help anyone.
question_patterns: why was griffin wandering the streets of london
why did griffin set fire to his landlord's house
what kind of a scientist was griffin
how did griffin become invisible
why is griffin called a lawless person
what problem did invisibility bring to griffin in winter

solution_steps.explain: In revenge for his landlord's attempts to evict him, Griffin set the house alight and fled.
A rare drug turned him transparent, forcing him to remain unclothed and unseen.
His genius carries no moral sense: he steals and frightens people for his own comfort.

concepts.title: Theatrical Shop and the Iping Lodging
concepts.definition: Griffin enters a large London store to clothe and feed himself invisibly, then escapes in the morning, and later books two rooms at an inn in the village of Iping, appearing as a mysterious stranger wrapped in bandages.
concepts.key_idea: At Iping his odd appearance and secretive habits set the village talking, and money that appears on the landlady's desk deepens the mystery.
question_patterns: how did griffin equip himself from the store in london

solution_steps.explain: Invisible, he dressed himself in warm clothes, ate and drank, and left the shop unseen with cash.
He lodged at the Coach and Horses with a bandaged face and false nose, claiming an accident.
Stolen money seemed to appear on the desk, so theft was suspected in the village.

concepts.title: Science Without Morality: The Story's Warning
concepts.definition: The story warns that science without moral restraint becomes a threat: Griffin's genius for invisibility serves theft, assault and terror until society turns against him.
concepts.key_idea: Invisibility becomes a curse because its owner lacks honesty, and the tale asks readers to weigh brilliance against responsibility.
question_patterns: what is the message of footprints without feet

how does the story show the misuse of science

solution_steps.explain: Arson, shoplifting, robbery of the clergyman, and terrorising the village follow his discovery.
The tale shows that knowledge detached from morality endangers both the scientist and society.
Griffin ends hunted and exposed, proving that lawlessness finds no safe hiding, even when invisible.
